description: The applications (programs of the desktop) and what is the same everywhere about them: their key, their colour and how they are called in a sentence. The hub reads this file (hub/src/topcoat_hub/applications.py); the web build keeps its own copy of the keys and colours (web/src/chat/applications.ts), and web/src/chat/applications.shared.test.ts checks that the two agree. A new application starts here.
